ns2:section.sectionText: ALL ACCY 202 SECTIONS RESTRICTED TO COLLEGE OF BUSINESS, ACE, ACES, CS & GE MAJORS. Accountancy course prerequisites are strictly enforced. The Accounting Department will not allow students to advance in the accounting curriculum if they have not met the required prerequisite for previous accountancy courses taken.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Technical Systems Management or Crop Sciences or Curric Unassigned or Accountancy or Finance or Business Administration or Computer Science or General Engineering or Agr & Consumer Economics or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Operations Management major(s).
